text:
Let me analyze these answers critically:

Agent 1 claims Peter Pan and the Lost Boys live in the Hundred Acre Wood with very high confidence (0.97). This is incorrect - Peter Pan and the Lost Boys live in Neverland, not the Hundred Acre Wood.

Agents 2, 3, and 4 all correctly identify that Winnie-the-Pooh and his friends live in the Hundred Acre Wood. This is the fictional setting created by A.A. Milne for the Winnie-the-Pooh stories. Agents 3 and 4 provide additional detail by listing the specific characters (Christopher Robin, Piglet, Eeyore, Tigger, Rabbit, Kanga, Roo, and Owl).

The Hundred Acre Wood is definitively the home of Winnie-the-Pooh and his friends
